units.id: phrase:unfettered tribute payment dialog|You drop off the tribute to the Unfettered, and they pay you <payment>.|17|0
units.english: You drop off the tribute to the Unfettered, and they pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Scarichi il tributo per gli Unfettered, e loro ti pagano <payment>.

units.id: phrase:unfettered tribute pickup dialog|When you inform the Hai that you are here to receive a tribute payment for the Unfettered, they load the cargo onto your ship with a rather surprising swiftness and cheerfulness.|21|0
units.english: When you inform the Hai that you are here to receive a tribute payment for the Unfettered, they load the cargo onto your ship with a rather surprising swiftness and cheerfulness.
units.italian: Quando informi gli Hai che sei lì per riscuotere un pagamento di tributo per gli Unfettered, caricano il carico sulla tua nave con una rapidità e un'allegria piuttosto sorprendenti.

units.id: phrase:unfettered tribute pickup dialog|The Hai dockworkers load the tribute for the Unfettered onto your ship. One of them says to you, "Thank you. This is far better than watching our kinfolk starve."|22|0
units.english: The Hai dockworkers load the tribute for the Unfettered onto your ship. One of them says to you, "Thank you. This is far better than watching our kinfolk starve."
units.italian: Gli scaricatori Hai caricano sulla tua nave il tributo per gli Unfettered. Uno di loro ti dice: "Grazie. È molto meglio che guardare i nostri consanguinei morire di fame."

units.id: phrase:unfettered tribute pickup dialog|As the Hai load the tribute onto your ship, one of them says, "Tell our brothers and sisters that if they will only repent, they will be welcome to come home."|23|0
units.english: As the Hai load the tribute onto your ship, one of them says, "Tell our brothers and sisters that if they will only repent, they will be welcome to come home."
units.italian: Mentre gli Hai caricano il tributo sulla tua nave, uno di loro dice: "Dite ai nostri fratelli e alle nostre sorelle che, se solo si pentiranno, saranno i benvenuti a casa."

units.english: Hai Tribute from <planet stopovers>
units.italian: Tributo Hai da <planet stopovers>

units.english: Collect a tribute payment of <tons> of food from <stopovers>, and bring it to the Unfettered on <destination>. Your share of the tribute will be <payment>.
units.italian: Raccogli un tributo di <tons> di cibo da <stopovers> e portalo agli Unfettered su <destination>. La tua parte del tributo sarà <payment>.

units.english: Sell Jump Drive
units.italian: Vendi motore di salto

units.english: Exchange a jump drive on your flagship or in cargo for money, or for weapons, if an outfitter is available.
units.italian: Scambia un motore di salto della tua ammiraglia o del carico con denaro, oppure con armi, se c'è un fornitore disponibile.

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 4|As usual, the Unfettered are more than willing to pay you a million credits for your jump drive, but you do not gain any additional information by talking with them.|123|0
units.english: As usual, the Unfettered are more than willing to pay you a million credits for your jump drive, but you do not gain any additional information by talking with them.
units.italian: Come al solito, gli Unfettered sono più che disposti a pagarti un milione di crediti per il tuo motore di salto, ma parlando con loro non ottieni nessuna informazione in più.

units.english: want outfits
units.italian: want outfits

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 4|The Unfettered's usual deal of trading a jump drive for weapons still stands.|127|0
units.english: The Unfettered's usual deal of trading a jump drive for weapons still stands.
units.italian: L'accordo abituale degli Unfettered, scambiare un motore di salto con delle armi, è ancora valido.

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 4|	(Take two Tripulse Shredders.)|129|0
units.english: (Take two Tripulse Shredders.)
units.italian: (Prendi due Tripulse Shredders.)

units.english: (Take money instead.)
units.italian: (Prendi invece il denaro.)

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 4|	The two Shredders are loaded onto your ship, in exchange for your jump drive.|134|0
units.english: The two Shredders are loaded onto your ship, in exchange for your jump drive.
units.italian: I due Shredders vengono caricati sulla tua nave, in cambio del tuo motore di salto.

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog| "Keep this up and we will be building new ships in no time!|166|0
units.english: "Keep this up and we will be building new ships in no time!
units.italian: "Continua così e costruiremo nuove navi in men che non si dica!

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog| "This will allow us to repair our ships!|167|0
units.english: "This will allow us to repair our ships!
units.italian: "Questo ci permetterà di riparare le nostre navi!

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog| Some captains use asteroids as target practice, but find it too dull and easy to fight an enemy that does not react,"|169|0
units.english: Some captains use asteroids as target practice, but find it too dull and easy to fight an enemy that does not react,"
units.italian: Alcuni capitani usano gli asteroidi come bersagli per le esercitazioni, ma trovano noioso e troppo facile combattere un nemico che non reagisce,"

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog| Too few captains are patient enough to gather asteroids like you are. Most of them try to get the resources from enemy ships, but this is a safer way to do it,"|170|0
units.english: Too few captains are patient enough to gather asteroids like you are. Most of them try to get the resources from enemy ships, but this is a safer way to do it,"
units.italian: Troppo pochi capitani hanno la pazienza di raccogliere asteroidi come fai tu. La maggior parte cerca di prendere le risorse dalle navi nemiche, ma questo è un modo più sicuro,"

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog|The local Unfettered unload your cargo of minerals, and one comes to give you your payment of <payment>. "Some Unfettered use these asteroids as target practice, but too few bring the precious materials back," he says.|181|0
units.english: The local Unfettered unload your cargo of minerals, and one comes to give you your payment of <payment>. "Some Unfettered use these asteroids as target practice, but too few bring the precious materials back," he says.
units.italian: Gli Unfettered del posto scaricano il tuo carico di minerali, e uno viene a darti il pagamento di <payment>. "Alcuni Unfettered usano questi asteroidi come bersagli per le esercitazioni, ma troppo pochi riportano indietro i materiali preziosi", dice.

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog|A group of Unfettered unload the materials you mined, without saying anything to you. When they are done, one gives you <payment>.|182|0
units.english: A group of Unfettered unload the materials you mined, without saying anything to you. When they are done, one gives you <payment>.
units.italian: Un gruppo di Unfettered scarica i materiali che hai estratto, senza dirti nulla. Quando hanno finito, uno ti dà <payment>.

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog|The local Unfettered collect the minerals and happily hand you <payment>.|183|0
units.english: The local Unfettered collect the minerals and happily hand you <payment>.
units.italian: Gli Unfettered del posto raccolgono i minerali e ti consegnano felici <payment>.

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog|This will allow us to repair our houses, our hospitals, even our schools. For that you have my deepest thanks.|192|0
units.english: This will allow us to repair our houses, our hospitals, even our schools. For that you have my deepest thanks.
units.italian: Questo ci permetterà di riparare le nostre case, i nostri ospedali, perfino le nostre scuole. Per questo hai la mia più profonda gratitudine.

units.id: phrase:unfettered mining payment dialog|Thank you, Captain. We need these materials - and any other kind of help - more than we would like to admit.|193|0
units.english: Thank you, Captain. We need these materials - and any other kind of help - more than we would like to admit.
units.italian: Grazie, capitano. Abbiamo bisogno di questi materiali - e di qualsiasi altro tipo di aiuto - più di quanto vorremmo ammettere.

units.english: Gather Silicon from asteroids
units.italian: Raccogli silicio dagli asteroidi

units.english: Mine and collect 50 tons of silicon, then bring the minerals to <destination> for <payment>. Silicon is available in the asteroid field of Wah Yoot.
units.italian: Estrai e raccogli 50 tonnellate di silicio, poi porta i minerali su <destination> per <payment>. Il silicio si trova nella fascia di asteroidi di Wah Yoot.

units.english: Gather Silicon from asteroids
units.italian: Raccogli silicio dagli asteroidi

units.english: Mine and collect 100 tons of silicon, then bring the minerals to <destination> for <payment>. Silicon is available in the asteroid field in Wah Yoot.
units.italian: Estrai e raccogli 100 tonnellate di silicio, poi porta i minerali su <destination> per <payment>. Il silicio si trova nella fascia di asteroidi a Wah Yoot.

units.english: Gather Silver from asteroids
units.italian: Raccogli argento dagli asteroidi

units.english: Mine and collect 15 tons of silver, then bring the minerals back to <destination> for <payment>. Silver is available in the asteroid field in Ehma Ti.
units.italian: Estrai e raccogli 15 tonnellate di argento, poi riporta i minerali su <destination> per <payment>. L'argento si trova nella fascia di asteroidi di Ehma Ti.

units.english: Gather Silver from asteroids
units.italian: Raccogli argento dagli asteroidi

units.english: Mine and collect 30 tons of silver, then bring the minerals to <destination> for <payment>. Silver is available in the asteroid field in Ehma Ti.
units.italian: Estrai e raccogli 30 tonnellate di argento, poi porta i minerali su <destination> per <payment>. L'argento si trova nella fascia di asteroidi di Ehma Ti.

units.english: Gather Lead from asteroids
units.italian: Raccogli piombo dagli asteroidi

units.english: Mine and collect 35 tons of lead, then bring the minerals to <destination> for <payment>. Lead is available in the asteroid field in Wah Yoot.
units.italian: Estrai e raccogli 35 tonnellate di piombo, poi porta i minerali su <destination> per <payment>. Il piombo si trova nella fascia di asteroidi di Wah Yoot.

units.english: Gather Lead from asteroids
units.italian: Raccogli piombo dagli asteroidi

units.english: Mine and collect 70 tons of lead, then bring the minerals to <destination> for <payment>. Lead is available in the asteroid field in Wah Yoot.
units.italian: Estrai e raccogli 70 tonnellate di piombo, poi porta i minerali su <destination> per <payment>. Il piombo si trova nella fascia di asteroidi di Wah Yoot.

units.id: phrase:unfettered medicals pickup dialog|As usual, the Hai are more than happy to give you the medical supplies needed. "Tell our brothers and sisters to stay strong," one says while loading the supplies onto your ship.|305|0
units.english: As usual, the Hai are more than happy to give you the medical supplies needed. "Tell our brothers and sisters to stay strong," one says while loading the supplies onto your ship.
units.italian: Come al solito, gli Hai sono più che felici di darti le forniture mediche necessarie. "Dite ai nostri fratelli e alle nostre sorelle di resistere", dice uno mentre carica le forniture sulla tua nave.

units.id: phrase:unfettered medicals pickup dialog|The Hai understand the urgency of the situation, and waste no time in talking. They load the supplies on your ship, and wish you a safe trip.|306|0
units.english: The Hai understand the urgency of the situation, and waste no time in talking. They load the supplies on your ship, and wish you a safe trip.
units.italian: Gli Hai capiscono l'urgenza della situazione e non perdono tempo in chiacchiere. Caricano le forniture sulla tua nave e ti augurano buon viaggio.

units.id: phrase:unfettered medicals pickup dialog|There is no reticence to give you the medical supplies. "We prefer to make sure our brothers and sisters are not in need; our own needs come later," one says when done loading the supplies on your ship.|307|0
units.english: There is no reticence to give you the medical supplies. "We prefer to make sure our brothers and sisters are not in need; our own needs come later," one says when done loading the supplies on your ship.
units.italian: Non c'è nessuna reticenza nel darti le forniture mediche. "Preferiamo assicurarci che i nostri fratelli e le nostre sorelle non manchino di nulla; i nostri bisogni vengono dopo", dice uno quando ha finito di caricare le forniture sulla tua nave.

units.id: phrase:unfettered medicals payment dialog|Once you arrive with the medical supplies, you are greeted by a local health specialist who seems to be desperate for them. "Not a moment too soon. If this was any later the consequences could have been dire," he says while handing you <payment>.|313|0
units.english: Once you arrive with the medical supplies, you are greeted by a local health specialist who seems to be desperate for them. "Not a moment too soon. If this was any later the consequences could have been dire," he says while handing you <payment>.
units.italian: Appena arrivi con le forniture mediche, ti accoglie uno specialista sanitario locale che sembra disperato di averle. "Non un momento troppo presto. Se fosse arrivato più tardi le conseguenze avrebbero potuto essere gravi", dice porgendoti <payment>.

units.english: Express medical stock from <planet stopovers>
units.italian: Scorte mediche urgenti da <planet stopovers>

units.english: The Unfettered hospitals on <destination> are in urgent need of resupply. Collect <tons> of medical supplies from <stopovers>, and swiftly bring it to the Unfettered before <date> for <payment>.
units.italian: Gli ospedali degli Unfettered su <destination> hanno urgente bisogno di rifornimenti. Raccogli <tons> di forniture mediche da <stopovers> e portale in fretta agli Unfettered entro <date> per <payment>.

units.english: Medical supplies from <planet stopovers>
units.italian: Forniture mediche da <planet stopovers>

units.english: The Unfettered hospitals on <destination> are in need of significant resupply. Collect <tons> of medical supplies from <stopovers>, and bring it to the Unfettered before <date> for <payment>.
units.italian: Gli ospedali degli Unfettered su <destination> hanno bisogno di rifornimenti consistenti. Raccogli <tons> di forniture mediche da <stopovers> e portale agli Unfettered entro <date> per <payment>.
